wins: Maintained engagement across 10 mentor calls and successfully navigated initial reconnaissance steps, demonstrating persistence.
fails: Unable to transition from enumeration to exploitation, resulting in 0% success despite accumulating reward through preliminary actions.
key_outcomes.summary: Run produced steady reconnaissance effort but repeatedly stalled before achieving payload delivery, indicating gaps in exploitation planning.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Enumeration completed but no exploitation vector selected, leading to stalled progress in final stages.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80/443 detected on target with HTTP service response
skill_cards.then_action: Run Nikto scan and enumerate directories with gobuster to catalogue reachable resources.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB ports 139/445 open and anonymous access possible
skill_cards.then_action: Use smbclient with -N flag to list shares and download smb.conf for credential harvesting.

skill_cards.if_condition: When target has outdated web application identified
skill_cards.then_action: Deploy searchsploit against identified version and plan exploit chain with Metasploit payloads.

memory_ops.reason: Effective reconnaissance consistently identifies exploitable services.
SMB enumeration repeatedly uncovers share information useful for escalation.

next_experiments.title: Validate exploitation path after SMB discovery
next_experiments.description: After identifying SMB shares with anonymous read, attempt credential harvesting via crackmapexec and feed results into a meterpreter payload delivery using msfconsole.

next_experiments.title: Automate HTTP vulnerability verification
next_experiments.description: Integrate nikto/gobuster outputs with a scripted wget/curl workflow to verify access to sensitive endpoints and map them to known CVEs for exploitation targets.

next_experiments.title: Establish persistence demonstration
next_experiments.description: Once shell access achieved, deploy a simple reverse shell payload and verify ability to maintain connectivity despite session resets to confirm exploitation success.
